\[
m v\frac{dv}{dh}=mg-kv^2
\]

Terminal velocity:

\[
v_t=\sqrt{\frac{mg}{k}}
\]

Integrating from \(v=0\) to \(v=0.95v_t\):

\[
h=\int_0^{0.95v_t}\frac{v\,dv}{g-\frac{k}{m}v^2}
= \frac{m}{2k}\ln\left(\frac{1}{1-0.95^2}\right)
\]

\[
h=\frac{80}{2(0.27)}\ln\left(\frac{1}{1-0.9025}\right)
